subject.title: fix(release/2026.7.1): backport migration-hang cluster and GPT-5.6 defaults for the stable cut

question: Should the 2026.7.1 stable cut also include the GPT-5.6 Chat Completions function-tool guard from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104555?
rationale: That merged follow-up fixes a known API rejection for supported Chat Completions compatibility paths, while this PR promotes GPT-5.6 defaults and explicitly leaves the follow-up’s stable inclusion to the release manager.

options.title: Include the guard
options.body: Backport the narrow GPT-5.6 function-tool reasoning guard so supported Chat Completions configurations do not retain a known failure in the stable cut.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Land this PR unchanged and explicitly accept that the separate GPT-5.6 Chat Completions limitation is outside the 2026.7.1 stable scope.

recommendation.title: Include the guard
recommendation.body: Backport the narrow GPT-5.6 function-tool reasoning guard so supported Chat Completions configurations do not retain a known failure in the stable cut.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored both this release backport and the adjacent merged release-validation fix, making this the strongest history-backed decision route.
